//addr: Listening address and port for the gateway server
//auth_token: Optional bearer token for authenticating admin API calls (/api/v1/admin/routes, /api/v1/admin/middleware)
//tls_cert: Path to TLS certificate file (leave empty for plain HTTP or Let's Encrypt autocert)

routes.//prefix: URL path prefix matched by incoming requests
routes.//target: Upstream service URL to proxy matching requests to
routes.//middleware: Optional WASM middleware identifier compiled/registered on the gateway
routes.//rate_limit_rpm: Max allowed requests per minute per IP for this route (0 = unlimited)

routes.//enable_semantic_cache: Enable AI semantic response caching (gracefully disabled if embedding service is offline)
routes.//enable_prompt_guard: Sanitize and inspect inputs for AI prompt injection attempts
